[Why We're Here](https://www.aikido.dev/company/about#)

All the security tools we used were slow, confusing, overpriced and noisy.

So we built better ones.

Tools developers actually want to use, and security teams can trust.

Now, we have category-leading security products across code, cloud, runtime, and autonomous penetration testing.

What makes them even stronger is context. By connecting code, cloud, and runtime data, our products work together to find the right issues and fix them faster.

Our vision is self-securing software. Security that continuously tests, validates, and improves itself as software is built and released.

Get security done.

So you can get back to building.
